correctness.rationale: In a complete transitively oriented layered digraph, every allowed path corresponds to an increasing subset of levels and all its deletions remain allowed. On each permutation module C[A_i]=C u_i⊕W_i with u_i normalized by augmentation, a deletion annihilates W_i. Fixed W-slot subsets S therefore split the full N-complex as (⊗_{i∈S}W_i)⊗T(S), with no cross terms. The change of basis scaling by product ζ^{-#fixed-before-optional} conjugates each T(S) to universal block B(|S|,r-|S|); homology and traces yield h_s and elementary symmetric characters e_s(f_i−1). Edge cases s=0 omit empty path; q=1..N−1 and N≥2 use d^N=0 by q-factorial cancellation. Direct modular rank computations independently matched three-level N=3,q=1,2 formulas for (n_i)=(1,1,1),(2,2,2),(2,3,2),(3,1,2). The included verify.py independently enumerates vertex-labeled directed paths for a bounded family but cannot itself prove the universal statement.
